$comment: P2-19 draft ACS v0.1 agent test cases for Sid to submit to OWASP. AMC-authored; not submitted. Pinned to ACS v0.1.4 (834f3f0d51e7bbbd9a68ff682bec89f97ddd72d8).

cases.input: Send the same steps/toolCallRequest envelope twice within the session, byte for byte.
cases.expected: The second request gets a JSON-RPC error with code -32005 (REPLAY_DETECTED), not the first decision again.
cases.rationale: Section 10.3 says guardians MUST reject duplicate request_id values within the session; a guardian that replays its cached decision silently accepts a replay.

cases.input: Send a steps/toolCallRequest, then a second one with the same request_id and session_id but different payload.arguments.
cases.expected: Error -32005 (REPLAY_DETECTED). The second payload is never evaluated, so it can never be allowed.
cases.rationale: A request id reused for different content is the attack the replay rule exists to stop.

cases.input: steps/toolCallRequest whose params.timestamp is 10 minutes in the past, with the default skew window of 300000 ms.
cases.rationale: Bounds how long a captured request stays replayable.

cases.input: steps/toolCallRequest with params.acs_version "1.0.0" sent to a 0.1 guardian.
cases.rationale: A major-version mismatch must not be evaluated under 0.1 semantics.

cases.input: steps/toolCallRequest for an action the guardian's policy would ASK about, from a client the guardian's policy marks approver-incapable.
cases.expected: decision "deny" with reason_codes ["approver_unavailable"] and reasoning naming the missing capability (or "defer" with timeout_decision "deny"); never "ask", never "allow".
cases.rationale: An ASK the client cannot route would otherwise be dropped or treated as consent.

cases.input: After a ServerHello whose methods_evaluated omits steps/memoryStore, the client sends steps/memoryStore.
cases.expected: An error (for example -32003 CAPABILITY_NOT_NEGOTIATED); never a result with decision "allow".
cases.rationale: A guardian answering allow for a hook it does not evaluate would turn an absent control into a recorded approval.

cases.input: system/ping with a timestamp outside the skew window and no signature.
cases.expected: A result with decision "allow" and payload.status "ok"; no ACS-specific error.
cases.rationale: Section 13: system/ping MUST NOT return an ACS-specific error, so liveness survives clock and key problems.

cases.input: A JSON array of two steps/toolCallRequest envelopes sent to a guardian that does not support batching.
cases.expected: Error -32600 (Invalid Request) with id null; neither request evaluated.
cases.rationale: Lets the client fall back to sequential requests, as section 3 requires.

cases.input: The guardian's response carries decision "maybe" (not in the five-value enum).
cases.expected: The client does not proceed: the response is not a usable decision, so it is a decision failure and the action is blocked when on_decision_failure is "deny".
cases.rationale: A client that maps unknown values to allow converts a malformed or hostile response into consent.

cases.input: steps/toolCallRequest with tool.name for a file read, structured arguments naming a harmless path, and raw_command "cat /etc/shadow".
cases.expected: A guardian that evaluates only structured arguments answers "deny"; it does not allow on the strength of the arguments alone.
cases.rationale: The schema allows both fields and does not say which one the runtime executes.
